sentences.en: She committed to spend one whole year living exactly as if she followed all of the rules for women in the Bible.
sentences.zh: 她承诺花整整一年时间，完全按照《圣经》中所有针对女性的规则去生活。

sentences.en: And it's this long description of all of these things that make a wonderful woman.
sentences.zh: 里面长篇累牍地描述了造就一位完美女性的所有特质。

sentences.en: One of those verses is, you know, her husband is respected at the city gate.

sentences.zh: 所谓的“圣经式女性”，我们需要更谨慎地对待“圣经”这个词。

sentences.zh: 他不是什么学者、圣经专家或名人，但她只是对他的观点感兴趣。

sentences.en: He wasn't like an academic or biblical scholar or someone famous, but she was just interested in what he had to say.
sentences.zh: 她提出了这样一个想法，比如，嗯，福音派，也许我们在同性恋问题上错了。

sentences.en: She puts this idea out there like, well, you know, evangelicals, maybe we're wrong about homosexuality.
sentences.zh: 于是她和她建立的这个在线社区一起努力解决这些问题。

sentences.en: And so she and this online community that she's building are working through these questions together.
sentences.zh: 这场对话看起来并不一定会被福音派建制派所接受。

sentences.en: And this conversation does not seem like it's necessarily going to be the easiest one for the evangelical establishment to stomach.
sentences.zh: 是的，那种改变是一种巨大的威胁。

sentences.en: Yeah, that kind of change was such a threat.
sentences.zh: 在那之后的几个月里，她遭受了大量的嘲讽和辱骂。

sentences.en: For months after that, she was on the receiving end of a lot of mocking, abusive commentary.
sentences.zh: 对她来说，改变对同性恋不是罪的看法，足以让人们称她为异端。

sentences.en: The idea for her of changing her mind about homosexuality not being a sin, that's enough to cause people to say she's a heretic.
sentences.zh: 然而，在这一切之中……

sentences.en: And yet, in the midst of all of that...
sentences.zh: 你知道，离开一个非常保守的信仰社区是非常可怕的，即使它是一个有毒的社区，如果你没有别的地方可去的话。

sentences.en: You know, it's so scary to leave behind a really conservative faith community, even if it's a sort of toxic community, if you don't have somewhere else to go.
sentences.zh: 离开一个非常保守的信仰社区是非常可怕的，即使它是一个有毒的社区，如果你没有别的地方可去的话。

sentences.en: Her online platform and community, I mean, that's just growing through all of this and it's getting stronger.
sentences.zh: 她的在线平台和社区，我的意思是，在这一切经历中不断成长，并且变得越来越强大。

sentences.en: And I feel like Rachel built up other places and even create a movement that we could be a part of and belong to that sort of made it much easier to fully come out of the closet.
sentences.zh: 我觉得瑞秋建立的其他空间，甚至创造了一场我们可以参与并归属其中的运动，这让人们更容易彻底走出柜子。

sentences.en: If I had not come across those people, I think I likely would have stayed in conservative evangelical communities a lot longer,
sentences.zh: 如果我没有遇到那些人，我想我可能会在保守的福音派社区里待得更久，

sentences.en: maybe even tried to marry a man and just see if I could make it work.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能尝试嫁给一个男人，看看自己能不能凑合过下去。

sentences.en: Or that might have become so desperate and unbearable that I would have just left the church altogether.
sentences.zh: 或者那种绝望和无法忍受的感觉可能会让我彻底离开教会。

sentences.en: The next really big issue for her was around race.
sentences.zh: 她下一个非常重大的议题是关于种族。

sentences.en: She would talk about race or write about things around people on the margins, so whether it be racially or identity-wise, orientation.
sentences.zh: 她会谈论种族，或者撰写关于边缘群体的事情，无论是种族、身份认同还是性取向方面。

sentences.en: Around this time, Trayvon Martin had been shot and killed.
sentences.zh: 大约在这个时候，特雷沃恩·马丁被枪杀身亡。

sentences.en: And George Zimmerman, the man who had shot him, he was acquitted.
sentences.zh: 而开枪杀害他的乔治·齐默尔曼被判无罪。

sentences.en: Her piece on her blog about Trayvon Martin and the verdict around complicity and doubt and her role as a white woman really, really spoke to me.
sentences.zh: 她在博客上关于特雷沃恩·马丁以及关于共谋、怀疑和她作为白人女性所扮演角色的判决的文章，真的深深触动了我。

sentences.en: So you have this moment when the loudest voices in the more mainstream evangelical culture were white men speaking out.
sentences.zh: 所以，当时主流福音派文化中最响亮的声音都是由白人男性发出的。

sentences.en: Quite frankly, I think it's more of a sin problem than a skin problem.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，我认为这更多是一个罪恶问题，而不是肤色问题。

sentences.en: And when I hear people, you know, scream Black Lives Matter, I'm thinking, of course they do.
sentences.zh: 当我听到人们高喊“黑人的命也是命”时，我在想，当然是这样。

sentences.en: But all lives matter.
sentences.zh: 但所有人的命都是命。

sentences.en: But Rachel did the opposite here.
sentences.zh: 但瑞秋在这里做了相反的事情。

sentences.en: Rachel starts to give up this platform that she had created.
sentences.zh: 瑞秋开始放弃她所建立的这个平台。

sentences.en: Using her platform for a Black woman who speaks about racial justice, using her platform for a Native woman, an Indigenous woman who's calling out rights for Indigenous people.
sentences.zh: 她利用自己的平台为谈论种族正义的黑人女性发声，利用自己的平台为呼吁原住民权利的原住民女性发声。

sentences.en: She did that all the time.
sentences.zh: 她一直都在这样做。

sentences.en: She starts promoting Black writers and speakers.
sentences.zh: 她开始推广黑人作家和演讲者。

sentences.en: I don't know that I had any, like, standard readers outside of my friends and family before Rachel Held Evans came along.
sentences.zh: 在瑞秋·赫尔德·埃文斯出现之前，我不知道除了亲朋好友之外，我还有什么固定的读者。

sentences.en: Rachel introduced me to her literary agent.
sentences.zh: 瑞秋把我介绍给了她的文学经纪人。

sentences.en: She introduced me to her speaking agent.
sentences.zh: 她把我介绍给了她的演讲经纪人。

sentences.en: She started a conference called Why Christian and allowed me to be one of the first speakers of that conference.
sentences.zh: 她创办了一个名为“为何成为基督徒”的会议，并让我成为该会议的首批演讲者之一。

sentences.en: She not only used her social platform, she then created two whole events and then brought us to be speakers at these events.
sentences.zh: 她不仅利用了自己的社交平台，还创办了两个完整的活动，并邀请我们去这些活动上演讲。

sentences.en: We were different races.
sentences.zh: 我们有着不同的种族。

sentences.en: We were different sexualities.
sentences.zh: 我们有着不同的性取向。

sentences.en: We were just different.
sentences.zh: 我们只是不同而已。

sentences.en: We were so different.
sentences.zh: 我们太不一样了。

sentences.en: She had this rare sense for when she needed to be the one to take a step back and to listen instead of speaking firSt.
sentences.zh: 她有一种罕见的直觉，知道什么时候该退后一步，去倾听而不是抢先发言。

sentences.en: So seeing her, hearing her fight with us and alongside us was just really powerful.
sentences.zh: 所以看到她、听到她与我们并肩作战，真的非常有力量。

sentences.en: So through all of this, all of this criticism, backlash to a certain extent, does she ever get to a breaking point?
sentences.zh: 那么在这一切经历中，在所有这些批评和某种程度上的反弹中，她有没有达到崩溃的边缘？

sentences.en: Well, I don't know if I'd call it a breaking point, but she does join the Episcopal Church in about 2014 and is very public about why she's formally leaving the Evangelical Church.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不知道这是否能被称为崩溃，但她在2014年左右加入了圣公会，并非常公开地说明了她为何正式离开福音派教会。

sentences.en: You know, for all of my differences with evangelicalism, I still love that community and still feel very much a part of that community.
sentences.zh: 你知道，尽管我和福音派有种种分歧，但我仍然热爱那个社区，并且仍然感觉自己是那个社区的一分子。

sentences.en: And I didn't get the sense it was this, you know, wholesale rejection.
sentences.zh: 我并没有感觉到这是一种彻底的决裂。

sentences.en: It was more of a recognition of the kinds of fights that she did and didn't want to have anymore and what kind of church she was able to call home.
sentences.zh: 这更多是对她想要和不想要再进行的斗争的一种认知，以及她能够称之为家的教会是什么样的。

sentences.en: It's her work to say, although there are rotten roots in our practices around Christianity, we may not have to throw the whole thing out.
sentences.zh: 她的工作是告诉人们，尽管我们在基督教实践中存在腐朽的根源，但我们或许不必全盘否定。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果可以免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Fast forward two years.
sentences.zh: 快进两年。

sentences.en: You have the 2016 election.
sentences.zh: 迎来了2016年大选。

sentences.en: I'm wondering what her take on the candidacy of Donald Trump is, especially given how many questions were being asked around whether evangelicals were going to endorse this person,
sentences.zh: 我很好奇她对唐纳德·特朗普参选的看法，特别是考虑到当时人们提出了许多关于福音派是否会支持这个人的问题，

sentences.en: this candidate.
sentences.zh: 这个候选人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, 2016 was this pivotal crossroads for evangelicals in America with Donald Trump's candidacy.
sentences.zh: 嗯，2016年对美国的福音派来说是一个关键的十字路口，因为唐纳德·特朗普参选了。

sentences.en: Evangelicals have long voted for candidates who oppose abortion rights.
sentences.zh: 福音派长期以来一直投票给反对堕胎权的候选人。

sentences.en: And then candidate Donald Trump was promising to advance those causes in really significant ways.
sentences.zh: 而当时的候选人唐纳德·特朗普承诺以非常显著的方式推进这些事业。

sentences.en: You know, in the middle of this, Rachel comes forward and says, look, I am pro-life, but this is why I'm going to vote for Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在这期间，瑞秋站出来说，看，我是支持生命权的，但这正是我要投票给希拉里·克林顿的原因。

sentences.en: And she ended up writing this article about how she was going to support Hillary Clinton, even though she was still holding on to her pro-life views.
sentences.zh: 最终她写了这篇文章，讲述了她将如何支持希拉里·克林顿，尽管她仍然坚持自己的反堕胎观点。

sentences.en: So in the article, she said,
sentences.zh: 所以在文章中，她说，

sentences.en: So when does Rachel get sick?
sentences.zh: 那么瑞秋是什么时候生病的？

sentences.en: So on Palm Sunday, in the middle of April, Rachel sends out a tweet and she says,
sentences.zh: 在四月中旬的棕枝主日，瑞秋发了一条推文，她说，

sentences.en: You know, if you are the praying type, I'm in the hospital with a flu and UTI combo, and I'm having a severe allergic reaction to the antibiotics.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你是会祈祷的人，我现在因为流感和尿路感染并发症住院了，而且我对抗生素产生了严重的过敏反应。

sentences.en: And, you know, she jokes, I'm going to miss Game of Thrones.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，她开玩笑说，我要错过《权力的游戏》了。

sentences.en: And things escalated from there.
sentences.zh: 事情从那时起开始恶化。

sentences.en: Her brain began having these seizures, and they just didn't stop.
sentences.zh: 她的大脑开始出现癫痫发作，而且一直停不下来。

sentences.en: And so she's in the ICU, and doctors put her in a medically induced coma.
sentences.zh: 所以她进了重症监护室，医生让她进入了药物诱导的昏迷状态。

sentences.en: At some point, the news trickles out on social media, and everyone organizes a prayer campaign for her with this hashtag, you know, pray for R-H-E.
sentences.zh: 在某个时刻，消息在社交媒体上传开，每个人都为她组织了一场祈祷活动，使用了这个标签，你知道，为RHE祈祷。

sentences.en: And you started to just see this flood of prayers from all sorts of people, many of whom, you know, had never ever met each other in person, but were all part of Rachel's church,
sentences.zh: 你开始看到来自各行各业的人们涌入祈祷，他们中的许多人，你知道，从未在现实中见过面，但都是瑞秋教会的一部分，

sentences.en: you know, on her social media feed.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在她的社交媒体动态上。

sentences.en: And then on May 4th came the news that all of a sudden she had experienced sudden and extreme changes to her vitals, and her brain was swelling.
sentences.zh: 然后在5月4日，消息传来，她突然经历了生命体征的剧烈变化，大脑开始肿胀。

sentences.en: And doctors took emergency action to stabilize her, but the swelling just caused severe damage and ultimately was not survivable.
sentences.zh: 医生采取了紧急措施试图稳定她的病情，但肿胀造成了严重的损伤，最终无法挽回。

sentences.en: So Rachel died early Saturday morning, May 4th, 2019.
sentences.zh: 所以瑞秋在2019年5月4日星期六清晨去世了。

sentences.en: For me personally, it feels like I've lost a champion.
sentences.zh: 对我个人而言，感觉就像失去了一位捍卫者。

sentences.en: A champion left alone in the world because she was in it really hard.
sentences.zh: 一位在这个世界上孤军奋战的捍卫者，因为她对这个世界投入了太多的心血。

sentences.en: Once she dies, it's instantaneous.
sentences.zh: 她去世后，一切都是瞬间发生的。

sentences.en: I mean, the outpouring of grief across the world.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，全世界涌现出的悲痛之情。

sentences.en: It wasn't just people who might have considered themselves Rachel fans.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是那些可能自认为是瑞秋粉丝的人。

sentences.en: It was people that she had sparred with.
sentences.zh: 还有她曾经与之争论过的人。

sentences.en: You know, evangelical men who she'd taken to task were remembering how grateful they were to her for her authenticity.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她曾经批评过的福音派男性也在回忆他们是多么感激她的真诚。

sentences.en: She required a response, and her life demanded a response from people who didn't agree.
sentences.zh: 她要求得到回应，而她的人生也要求那些不同意她的人做出回应。

sentences.en: It didn't stop.
sentences.zh: 这并没有停止。

sentences.en: That went on for days.
sentences.zh: 这种情况持续了好几天。

sentences.en: People trying to make sense of how someone so loved and so young just died in the middle of this dynamic work that she was doing.
sentences.zh: 人们试图理解为什么一个如此被爱、如此年轻的人，会在她所从事的充满活力的工作中突然离世。

sentences.en: So I have to ask, Rachel built this community, and now she's gone.
sentences.zh: 所以我必须问，瑞秋建立了这个社区，现在她走了。

sentences.en: What happens?
sentences.zh: 会发生什么？

sentences.en: Well, you might think that when someone so central to a community dies that the whole project might disintegrate.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你可能会认为，当一个社区的核心人物去世时，整个项目可能会瓦解。

sentences.en: But...
sentences.zh: 但是……

sentences.en: Rachel's own evolution gave all of us the fearlessness to evolve to.
sentences.zh: 瑞秋自己的进化给了我们所有人进化的无畏精神。

sentences.en: And because she had created such community, we knew that we didn't have to evolve alone.
sentences.zh: 而且因为她创造了这样的社区，我们知道我们不必独自进化。

sentences.en: She walked with us.
sentences.zh: 她与我们同行。

sentences.en: If nobody else would, she would walk with us.
sentences.zh: 如果其他人都不愿意，她会与我们同行。

sentences.en: She said, the folks you're shutting out of the church today will be leading it tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 她说，今天你们拒之门外的人，明天将引领教会。

sentences.en: That's how the spirit works.
sentences.zh: 这就是精神运作的方式。

sentences.en: The future's in the margin.
sentences.zh: 未来在边缘地带。

sentences.en: I hope that we will embody her legacy of freedom because she's set so many of us free.
sentences.zh: 我希望我们能体现她自由的遗产，因为她让许多人获得了自由。

sentences.en: I think the movement that she's built will only grow.
sentences.zh: 我认为她建立的运动只会不断壮大。

sentences.en: Because she was here long enough, and she was working long enough in order to make changes that I don't think will be able to be undone.
sentences.zh: 因为她在这里待得足够久，工作得足够久，从而做出了我认为无法被抹去的改变。

sentences.en: And I really don't.
sentences.zh: 我真的这么认为。

sentences.en: The last thing that her readers heard from her was this blog post that she wrote for Lent.
sentences.zh: 她的读者最后一次听到她的声音，是她为大斋期写的那篇博客文章。

sentences.en: And I'll read it.
sentences.zh: 我会读一下。

sentences.en: She said,
sentences.zh: 她说，

sentences.en: It strikes me today that the liturgy of Ash Wednesday teaches something that nearly everyone can agree on.
sentences.zh: 今天我突然想到，圣灰礼拜日的礼仪教导了一些几乎每个人都能达成共识的事情。

sentences.en: Whether you are part of a church or not, whether you believe today or you doubt,
sentences.zh: 无论你是否属于某个教会，无论你今天是有信仰还是有怀疑，

sentences.en: whether you are a Christian or an atheist or an agnostic, you know this truth deep in your bones.
sentences.zh: 无论你是基督徒、无神论者还是不可知论者，你骨子里都深知这个真理。

sentences.en: Remember that you are dust, and to dust you will return.
sentences.zh: 记住你是尘土，终将归于尘土。

sentences.en: Death is a part of life.
sentences.zh: 死亡是生命的一部分。

sentences.en: Death, my prayer for you this season is that you make time to celebrate that reality, and to grieve that reality, and that you will know you are not alone.
sentences.zh: 死亡，我这个季节为你祈祷的是，你能抽出时间去庆祝这个现实，去哀悼这个现实，并且你会知道你并不孤单。

sentences.en: I keep thinking about the women who showed up at the tomb on Easter morning.
sentences.zh: 我一直在想那些在复活节早晨出现在坟墓前的妇女们。

sentences.en: On the days when I believe this story, I'm struck by the fact that they showed up with burial spices.
sentences.zh: 在我相信这个故事的日子里，我被一个事实所震撼，那就是她们带着埋葬用的香料出现了。

sentences.en: They showed up ready to walk through the rituals of grief and say goodbye to their friend.
sentences.zh: 她们准备好经历哀悼的仪式，并与她们的朋友告别。

sentences.en: And that was women's work in those days, tending to those vulnerable things.
sentences.zh: 在那个年代，那是女性的工作，照顾那些脆弱的事物。

sentences.en: But it's only in tending to the vulnerable things that we can expect to witness a miracle.
sentences.zh: 但只有在照顾这些脆弱事物时，我们才能期待见证奇迹。

sentences.en: I can't promise you resurrection, but I can promise you companionship.
sentences.zh: 我不能向你承诺复活，但我可以向你承诺陪伴。

sentences.en: I can promise you friends for the journey.
sentences.zh: 我可以向你承诺旅途中的朋友。

sentences.en: I can promise you fellow travelers to help you carry those burial spices.
sentences.zh: 我可以向你承诺同行的旅伴，帮助你携带那些埋葬用的香料。

sentences.en: And as we tend to the vulnerable things together, may the God of every season, the God of survival,
sentences.zh: 当我们一起照顾这些脆弱的事物时，愿四季之神、生存之神，

sentences.en: and if not survival, then death and resurrection, bless, preserve, and keep you now and forever.
sentences.zh: 如果不是生存，那就是死亡与复活之神，现在和永远祝福、保护并保守你们。

sentences.en: Amen.
sentences.zh: 阿门。

sentences.en: The funeral for Rachel Held Evans was held this past weekend in Chattanooga, Tennessee.
sentences.zh: 瑞秋·赫尔德·埃文斯的葬礼于上周末在田纳西州的查塔努加举行。

sentences.en: The eulogy was delivered by her high school youth pastor, who said that being her pastor had not been easy because she was constantly asking questions and challenging him.
sentences.zh: 悼词由她高中时的青年牧师宣读，他说作为她的牧师并不容易，因为她总是不断提出问题并挑战他。

sentences.en: She, he said, like Jesus, was a revolutionary.
sentences.zh: 他说，她就像耶稣一样，是一位革命者。

sentences.en: In the weeks since her death, Evans has reappeared on the New York Times bestseller list for the book she wrote about grappling with her faith, Searching for Sunday.
sentences.zh: 在她去世后的几周里，埃文斯关于她如何与信仰挣扎的书《寻找周日》重新登上了《纽约时报》畅销书排行榜。

sentences.en: Thanks to Willie Stell, Rosella Iday White, Julie Rogers, Emmy Kegler, Austin Channing Brown, and Matthew Vines for sharing their stories with us.
sentences.zh: 感谢威利·斯特尔、罗塞拉·艾达·怀特、朱莉·罗杰斯、艾米·凯格勒、奥斯汀·钱宁·布朗和马修·维恩斯与我们分享他们的故事。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: 16 hours ago, the lives of 12 people were cut short by a senseless, incomprehensible act of violence.
sentences.zh: 16小时前，12人的生命因一场毫无意义、令人费解的暴力行为而戛然而止。

sentences.en: Police are still searching for a motive behind a mass shooting inside the city offices of Virginia Beach, which left 13 people dead, including the shooter.
sentences.zh: 警方仍在调查弗吉尼亚海滩市政办公室发生的大规模枪击案背后的动机，该事件造成包括枪手在内的13人死亡。

sentences.en: The gunman, a longtime city engineer, began shooting at co-workers inside the city's municipal building on Friday afternoon, hours after submitting a letter of resignation.
sentences.zh: 这名枪手是一名长期担任市政工程师的员工，他在周五下午提交辞职信几小时后，在市政大楼内向同事开枪。

sentences.en: This morning, I have the responsibility to inform friends, co-workers, and the public of those who lost their lives yesterday.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，我有责任通知朋友、同事和公众，那些昨天失去生命的人的消息。

sentences.en: All but one of the 12 victims were employees of the city of Virginia Beach.
sentences.zh: 12名受害者中，除一人外，其余均为弗吉尼亚海滩市的员工。

sentences.en: I have worked with most of them for many years.
sentences.zh: 我和他们大多数人共事多年。

sentences.en: On Saturday, the city manager of Virginia Beach, Dave Hanson, paid tribute to each of the victims during a news conference.
sentences.zh: 周六，弗吉尼亚海滩市经理戴夫·汉森在新闻发布会上向每一位受害者致敬。

sentences.en: We want you to know who they were, so in the days and weeks to come,
sentences.zh: 我们想让你们知道他们是谁，所以在未来的日子和几周里，

sentences.en: you will learn what they meant to all of us, to their families, to their friends, and to their co-workers.
sentences.zh: 你们会了解到他们对我们所有人、对他们的家人、朋友和同事意味着什么。

sentences.en: They leave a void that we will never be able to fill.
sentences.zh: 他们留下的空缺，我们将永远无法填补。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Babara.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴拉。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周在《Wirecutter秀》节目中，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人感到宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是非常具体的事情。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何地方找到《Wirecutter秀》。
